purpose: Independently verify the unchanged exported corpus after the first six-hour recovery expired during host sleep; preserve the original acquisition and recovery failures
operations: Verify exact fixed prefix against the preserved pre-restart SHA256 manifest

restart_rule: Original acquisition stays stopped. A separately authorized finalization deadline is fixed once and never reset by process replacement. A new failure remains failed.
authorization_scope: The human directed active continuation after the exhausted six-hour run and asked to stop repeating that prompt. New separately declared24-hour wall/six-hour cumulative active budget. Earlier acquisition and six-hour recovery failures remain failed. No automatic renewal.
source_policy: Archive committed code and holdouts before running export/replay. Later working-tree changes cannot alter stages.
exclusions: No new generation, model training, model selection, opponent match or release runs inside this finalization budget. Those retain their separate experiment contracts.
checkpoint_policy: Full-synchronous WAL; expected inputs, contributors, cursor, counters and prefix digest commit together. Resume requires the externally pinned bytes of the owned stopped index and identical source/data bindings. The old malformed journal-OFF index is not reusable.
resource_basis: The failed original replay used1756.62childCPU seconds and6120.11active seconds for98816pairs before sleep consumed its wall budget.
